record.bible_text: Now the days<WH03117> of David<WH01732> drew nigh<WH07126><WTH8799> that he should die<WH04191><WTH8800>; and he charged<WH06680><WTH8762> Solomon<WH08010> his son<WH01121>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

That the LORD<WH03068> may continue<WH06965><WTH8686> his word<WH01697> which he spake<WH01696><WTH8765> concerning me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, If thy children<WH01121> take heed<WH08104><WTH8799> to their way<WH01870>, to walk<WH03212><WTH8800> before<WH06440> me in truth<WH0571> with all their heart<WH03824> and with all their soul<WH05315>, there shall not fail<WH03772><WTH8735> thee (said<WH0559><WTH8800> he) a man<WH0376> on the throne<WH03678> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>fail...: Heb. be cut off from thee from the throne<Rf>
